name: Enyoi Store Info
author: miroku

sections.description:
Enyoi Store Info is a comprehensive plugin designed for beauty salons and small businesses to easily display their store information. The plugin offers multiple display methods including Gutenberg blocks, shortcodes, widgets, and template functions.

Key Features:

  • Store Information Management: Centralized settings for all store details
  • Multiple Display Options: Blocks, shortcodes, widgets, and template functions
  • Google Maps Integration: Embed interactive maps with iframe support
  • Mobile-Friendly: Responsive design with click-to-call functionality
  • Easy Setup: Simple configuration through WordPress admin
  • Multisite Compatible: Works with WordPress multisite installations

Supported Information:

  • Store name
  • Address
  • Phone number (with mobile click-to-call)
  • Email address (with mailto links)
  • Business hours
  • Closed days
  • Access information
  • Parking information
  • Google Maps integration

Display Methods:

  1. Gutenberg Block: Add “Store Information” block in the block editor
  2. Shortcode: Use [enyoi_store_info] anywhere in posts or pages
  3. Widget: Add to sidebars or widget areas
  4. Template Function: Use enyoi_store_info() in theme files

The plugin is optimized for beauty salons but works perfectly for any business type. All information is managed from a single settings page and automatically synchronized across all display methods.

Third-party Services:

This plugin integrates with Google Maps to provide map embedding functionality:

  • Service: Google Maps Embed API (https://www.google.com/maps)
  • Purpose: Display interactive maps showing your business location
  • Data transmitted: Your business address/location coordinates when users view the embedded map
  • When data is sent: Only when users load pages containing the embedded map
  • Google Maps Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/maps/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

The Google Maps integration is optional. You can use all other plugin features without connecting to any external services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/enyoi-store-info/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Store Information to configure your store details.
  4. Use any of the following methods to display your store information:
    • Add “Store Information” block in the Gutenberg editor
    • Use the [enyoi_store_info] shortcode
    • Add the “Store Information Widget” to widget areas
    • Use enyoi_store_info() function in theme files
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with any WordPress theme?

Yes! While optimized for the Enyoi theme, this plugin works with any WordPress theme. The display will adapt to your theme’s styling.

How do I add Google Maps to my store information?

  1. Go to Google Maps and search for your location
  2. Click “Share” → “Embed a map”
  3. Copy the iframe code and paste it in the Google Maps URL field in plugin settings
  4. The map will automatically display with your store information

Can I customize the display layout?

Yes, the plugin provides CSS classes for custom styling. You can also use the compact display mode for sidebar widgets.

Does it work with mobile devices?

Absolutely! The plugin includes mobile-optimized features like click-to-call phone numbers and responsive design.

Can I use multiple display methods simultaneously?

Yes, you can use blocks, shortcodes, widgets, and template functions at the same time. All will show the same information from your settings.

Is it compatible with multisite installations?

Yes, the plugin fully supports WordPress multisite networks with individual settings per site.
